jobs.description: Job description Are you an ambitious Instrumentation Technician (E&I) from South Africa who is ready to build an international career in the Netherlands? Xelvin is looking for talented technicians who want to work in one of Europe's leading petrochemical environments. As an Instrumentation Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, calibrating and troubleshooting instrumentation and electrical systems that are essential for safe and reliable plant operations. You will join a highly skilled maintenance team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are key priorities. This position is based in Geleen, one of the largest industrial and petrochemical hubs in the Netherlands. Your responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on instrumentation and electrical systems. Calibrate pressure, temperature, flow and level transmitters. Troubleshoot electrical and instrumentation faults. Install and commission new field instrumentation. Read and interpret P&IDs, loop drawings and electrical schematics. Assist during plant shutdowns and turnarounds. Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and quality standards. Contribute to improving plant reliability and equipment performance. Employment conditions At Xelvin, we do much more than help you find a job. We help you build a future in the Netherlands. You can expect: A salary between €3,800 and €4,700 gross per month Full-time employment with long-term career opportunities Overtime and shift allowances where applicable 25 vacation days plus holiday allowance Pension scheme Extensive training and development opportunities Personal guidance throughout your career Complete relocation support Moving to another country is a big step. That's why Xelvin supports you throughout the entire relocation process. Our relocation package includes: Work visa and residence permit support Assistance with finding suitable accommodation Flight to the Netherlands Airport pick-up Municipal registration (BSN)Opening a Dutch bank account Health insurance guidance Dutch language lessons Ongoing support from your dedicated Xelvin Consultant Job requirements We are looking for motivated professionals who are ready to take the next step in their international career. You have: A recognised trade qualification in Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I), Instrumentation or Electrical Engineering. Experience as an Instrumentation Technician or E&I Technician. Experience within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical or Chemical industry. Knowledge of process instrumentation, control valves and field devices. Experience reading P&IDs and electrical drawings. Good English communication skills. Afrikaans language skills (preferred). A proactive attitude and willingness to relocate to the Netherlands. Preferably between 23 and 28 years old, making this an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to build an international career. About the organisation Xelvin has over 20 years of experience in connecting technical professionals with leading companies throughout the Netherlands. Every year we help engineers and technicians from South Africa relocate successfully to the Netherlands, where they build long-term careers with international employers. Xelvin provides comprehensive relocation assistance, from immigration support to housing and settling into Dutch life. Our client operates in one of Europe's largest petrochemical clusters and is committed to innovation, safety and sustainability. You will work with modern technologies in an international environment where technical expertise is highly valued.

Are you strong in planning, organizing, and maintaining oversight in a dynamic logistics environment? Do you enjoy improving processes while supporting a fast-growing operation? Then the role of Operations Planner in Moerdijk could be your next career move. Working in one of the largest and most modern warehouses in the Benelux, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth flow of daily order operations. You will make sure everything behind the scenes is perfectly coordinated, allowing the operation to perform at its best.As an Operations Planner, you will be responsible for the warehouse's outbound planning activities. You will ensure that customer orders are properly prepared, scheduled, and processed within the operation. Working closely with the operational teams, you will act as a key link between systems, planning, and execution.Your responsibilities include:- Processing daily customer requests and forecasts;- Planning and prioritizing outbound orders within the system;- Aligning capacity and operational activities with the warehouse floor;- Coordinating pick-and-pack processes to ensure orders are processed efficiently;- Acting as the first point of contact for operational planning-related questions;- Monitoring the progress, timing, and accuracy of order flows;- Ensuring that all process steps are followed strictly from start to finish;- Supporting the optimization of planning and logistics processes.For this position, we are looking for someone who excels at planning and can maintain a clear overview in a complex logistics environment.- Relevant experience within logistics (planning and/or warehouse operations);- Strong organizational and administrative skills;- Ability to work under pressure and effectively prioritize tasks;- Good command of the English language (required);- Comfortable working with computers and digital systems;- Available to work full-time in a two-shift schedule.

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute to people's health and well-being? Do you enjoy working accurately and carefully? Then join Rhenus Warehousing Solutions in Tilburg as a warehouse employee! In this responsible role, you will ensure that our high-quality medical products are processed with care and reach their destination on time and in perfect condition. You will work in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same and where your accuracy and commitment are truly valued. In addition, you will have plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow within the company.As a warehouse employee, you are an important link within our medical department. Here, everything revolves around processing and delivering high-quality products quickly and accurately, often directly to the operating room. Thanks to your attention to detail and sense of responsibility, you contribute to a smooth and reliable order fulfillment process. Your first few weeks will focus on an extensive onboarding period with targeted training, ensuring that you become familiar with all aspects of the job.After successfully completing your onboarding and training, your responsibilities will include:- Accurate order picking: You collect the correct medical products and ensure that every order is complete.- Careful packing: You pack products according to applicable guidelines and safety standards.- Supporting inbound goods: You assist with checking, sorting and receiving incoming deliveries.- Quality control: You carefully inspect products and ensure they meet the required high-quality standards.- Various warehouse activities: You support the team wherever needed and carry out tasks based on the daily needs of our customers.What do we expect from you?- Good command of the English language- You are available 40 hours per week, from 09:00 to 18:00- You are willing to work overtime when necessary- You are flexible, accurate and willing to take on differe

We are looking for young film critics! Cinekid is looking for English-speaking children between 4 - 14 years to join 'Ask Your Audience' in smaller focus groups. We are looking for young film critics! During Cinekid for Professionals this October, international filmmakers get the opportunity to present their new projects to the most important audience: kids themselves. 'Ask Your Audience' is a unique opportunity for children who love storytelling and movies, to have a real impact on the films and shows they will be watching in the future.  Who are we looking for? We are looking for English-speaking children or school groups between the ages 4 to 14. They will be joining smaller focus groups, depending on their age. After a quick presentation by selected filmmakers, kids will have the opportunity to ask questions about anything related to the project as well as share their opinions. A moderator will guide the sessions, to support a valuable exchange between the filmmakers and their young critics.  When and where will it happen? Ask Your Audience will take place during Cinekid Festival at Pathé Amsterdam Noord on 21, 22 and 23 October . Children will join us for 1 - 2 hours, depending on their age. We will share a more detailed schedule closer to the event.  What can we offer? To thank the children for their feedback, we can offer them the full Cinekid Festival experience; a complementary ticket for a festival screening and access to the MediaLab.  How can you apply? If your child is interested in participating or you would like to get more information about the programme, please contact us at professionals@cinekid.nl with the subject 'Ask Your Audience 2025'. Please include the age of your child and sign up before 24 September.
